subject: PoC gating & deployment ops matrix for Clearwell privacy pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PoC gating & deployment ops matrix for Clearwell privacy pilot

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap so we have a shared starting point and clear asks for the PoC selection decision.

TL;DR: there are three feasible deployment paths we discussed (Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, Private VPC/on-prem). Each has tradeoffs for compliance, time-to-value, and integration effort. Below I’ve mapped recommended PoC approaches by path and a short checklist of gating items we need from Clearwell to proceed.

1) Hosted API (fastest):
- PoC: 1–2 week smoke test using synthetic or de-identified records in our hosted environment.
- Good for functional parity and prompt tuning, but not suitable for PHI/regulated data.
- Key deliverable: sample inference flows + evaluation prompts.

2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs):
- PoC: 3–4 week load and latency validation in a dedicated tenant.
- Better isolation and stable throughput; still uses Redwood managed control plane.
- Key deliverable: expected QPS, model size preference, and acceptance latency (p95/p99).

3) Private VPC / on-prem (full isolation):
- PoC: 4–8 week staging engagement to validate networking, KMS/HSM, and EHR integration.
- Required for PHI or strict data residency.
- Key deliverable: network ACLs, contact for your infra, and security questionnaire.

Suggested next steps (to pick path + get PoC scheduled):
- Confirm top deployment preference (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC).
- Share the list of internal stakeholders (infra, security, compliance, product, SRE).
- Provide traffic profile: expected concurrent requests, peak QPS, average sequence length.
- Indicate timeline goals (target kickoff dates).

Proposed PoC plan if you want to de-risk quickly: start with a Hosted smoke test (1–2 weeks) using de-identified data to prove functional parity, then graduate to a Private VPC staging run for integration/security validation. I included a PoC template with roles, success criteria, and timeline for your team to fill out (attachment: clearwell_poc_template.xlsx).

Open items for Clearwell:
- Do you require PHI inside the PoC? (yes/no)
- Primary latency SLO for critical workflows (p95 target)
- Integration point: direct SFTP / API to your EMR / other

If you prefer, we can set up a 30-minute decision call next week to finalize the path and owners.

Thanks — I’ll prepare a draft cost comparison (Dedicated vs Private) once you confirm the preferred track.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: clearwell_poc_template.xlsx (spreadsheet: roles, success criteria, timeline)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC gating & deployment ops matrix for Clearwell privacy pilot

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side after the internal sync: we are leaning strongly toward Private VPC because the PoC will necessarily touch PHI for realistic integration testing with our EHR. Hosted or Dedicated would be ok for an initial *functional* smoke test, but we need the integration validation to be under our network and KMS.

Short answers to your open items:
- PHI in PoC: yes (we will provide a limited data sweep for acceptance testing).
- Latency SLO: critical patient-facing inference must be < 200ms p95. Batch ingestion jobs can be slower.
- Traffic profile: expected steady-state ~30 requests/min for first phase, spikes up to 150 requests/min during business hours; median token length ~120.
- Integration: we need an API adapter to our on-prem FHIR gateway and SFTP for bulk transfers.

Timeline: we want to have a staging integration started before year-end. Target kickoff window: between 2026-12-06 and 2026-12-20. Would that be possible?

Stakeholders:
- Security: Ben Cho (ben.cho@clearwellhealth.com)
- Infra: Michael Ortiz (michael.ortiz@clearwellhealth.com)
- Product: Samantha Lee (me)
- Compliance: Kara Nguyen (kara.nguyen@clearwellhealth.com)

Please send the security questionnaire and a draft cost comparison for Dedicated vs Private VPC so our procurement team can budget. Also can you confirm what network logs and audit retention options you support (S3 export, SIEM integrations)?

Thanks,
Samantha

Subject: Re: PoC gating & deployment ops matrix for Clearwell privacy pilot

Samantha — great, really helpful. We can meet your year-end target and will propose a phased PoC to reduce risk:

Phase A (1 week): Hosted smoke test with de-identified sample payloads to validate model behavior and evaluation prompts. No PHI exchanged.
Phase B (3–5 weeks): Private VPC staging deployment to validate networking, KMS integration, and end-to-end latency with real data inside your environment.

Key acceptance criteria (draft):
- Functional parity: match or exceed current embeddings-based retrieval accuracy on the provided prompt set (AUC/recall targets to be defined in PoC template).
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for critical inference paths in staging.
- Security: successful completion of our onboarding checklist + SOC2 evidence; network peering tests pass.

I attached our private onboarding checklist for your infra and security teams (attachment: redwood_private_onboarding_checklist.pdf). I’ll also push a draft cost comparison for Dedicated vs Private VPC (spreadsheet: redwood_cost_estimate-draft.xlsx) by EOD tomorrow.

Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff for the week of 2026-11-29 to finalize owners and confirm the target kickoff date (Dec 6 window)? I’ll invite Logan (solutions lead) and Vivek (deployment lead) to that call.

Thanks,
Marissa
